roles.Editor: select/focus ephemeral; explicit edit sends raw candidate; install button disabled unsupported/busy/stale/nonwriter; render designDoc from owner projection
roles.Viewer: read-only document, mock actions only; editing/save/Undo/agent/git actions absent; no broad privileged bootstrap
roles.MissingBinding: show bind/adopt explanation, disable all content actions, no guessed UUID or raw root

fields: existing persistent design fields remain C1 representation; UI display clamps/defaults in separate projection only. Candidate JSON text not retyped into lossy DTO before HOST guard.
errors: inline inert text+focusable summary/aria-live; retained prior projection on failed refresh; no auto silent repair or error-to-success toast
accessibility: keyboard selection and Enter/Space mock activate; explicit Editor/Viewer role label; focus restore after failed candidate; unsupported state announced
unsupported: read-only placeholders retain IDs/source content, explicit list, no Form insertion or scope stamp; no built-in conversion in this slice
confirmation: dirty close/discard and writer transfer explicit confirmation; stale preview Refresh explicit; no hidden autosave
release: Until M04 persistence seam accepted show saving unavailable; no release claim based only on mock/owner tests.
